                var g   = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.value = f;
                osc.connect(g);
                g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                var start = now + idx * dur;
                g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
                g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.12, start + 0.01);
                g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + dur);
                osc.start(start);
                osc.stop(start + dur + 0.02);
            });
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    /* ============================================================
     *  HOTKEYS
     * ============================================================ */
    function bindHotkeys() {
        $window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.altKey && (e.key === 'n' || e.key === 'N')) {
                e.preventDefault();
                c.tap();
                $scope.$applyAsync();
            }
            if (e.altKey && e.shiftKey && (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R')) {
                // R2.7 - Alt+Shift+R = NUCLEAR reset (history, mic, rec, AudioContext)
                e.preventDefault();
                logEvent('warn', 'Alt+Shift+R: nuclear reset of everything');
                geminiHistory = [];
                recRestartCount = 0;
                ignoreFinalsUntil = Date.now();
                try { if (contRec) contRec.stop(); } catch (er) {}
                try { stopMicLevelMeter(); } catch (e2) {}
                $timeout(function () {
                    startContinuous();
                    startMicLevelMeter();
                }, 300);
                $scope.$applyAsync();
                return;
            }
            if (e.altKey && (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R')) {
                // R1.1 - Alt+R = force restart recognition (escape hatch)
                e.preventDefault();
                logEvent('dev', 'Alt+R: force restart recognition');
                recRestartCount = 0;
                ignoreFinalsUntil = Date.now();
                try { if (contRec) contRec.stop(); } catch (er) {}
                $timeout(startContinuous, 200);
                $scope.$applyAsync();
            }
            if (e.altKey && (e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D')) {
                e.preventDefault();
                c.toggleDev();
                $scope.$applyAsync();
            }
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                if (TTS) TTS.cancel();
                ignoreFinalsUntil = Date.now() + TTS_GUARD_MS;
                setState(c.alert ? 'idle' : 'dormant');
                $scope.$applyAsync();
            }
        });
    }

    /* ============================================================
     *  NOTIFICATION POLLING
     * ============================================================ */
    function startNotificationPolling() {
        var POLL_MS = 9000;
        var tick = function () {
            c.data.action = 'poll';
            c.server.update().then(
                function () {
                    var list = c.data.notifications || [];
                    if (list.length) logEvent('poll', list.length + ' new');
                    list.forEach(function (n) {
                        if (seenIds[n.id]) return;
                        seenIds[n.id] = true;
                        if (c.state === 'listening' || c.state === 'speaking' || c.state === 'awaiting') return;
                        if (!c.alert) return;  // don't disturb when dormant
                        c.spoken = n.message;
                        $scope.$applyAsync();
                        speak(n.message);
                    });
                },
                function () { /* silent */ }
            ).finally(function () {
                pollTimer = $timeout(tick, POLL_MS);
            });
        };
        pollTimer = $timeout(tick, 3000);
    }

    /* ============================================================
     *  DEV PANEL ACTIONS
     * ============================================================ */
    c.toggleDev = function () {
        c.devOn = !c.devOn;
        logEvent('dev', 'panel ' + (c.devOn ? 'shown' : 'hidden'));
    };

    c.devKey = function (e) {
        if (e && e.keyCode === 13) {
            e.preventDefault();
            c.devSendText();
        }
    };

    c.devSendText = function () {
        var t = (c.devText || '').trim();
        if (!t) return;
        c.devText = '';
        logEvent('dev', 'manual send: "' + t + '"');
        unlockAudio();
        // Run through the same pipeline as a voice command
        processCommand(t, 1.0);
    };

    c.devListenNow = function () {
        unlockAudio();
        logEvent('dev', 'manual arm - next utterance is the command');
        commandMode = true;
        setState('awaiting');
        cue('wake');
        if (commandTimer) $timeout.cancel(commandTimer);
        commandTimer = $timeout(function () {
            if (commandMode) {
                commandMode = false;
                logEvent('wake', 'manual arm timed out');
                setState(c.alert ? 'idle' : 'dormant');
            }
        }, WAKE_TIMEOUT_MS);
    };

    c.devTestTTS = function () {
        unlockAudio();
        logEvent('dev', 'TEST TTS using ' + c.voiceName);
        speak('This is a test of the voice. Kindly let me know if you can hear me clearly. I am Netra, speaking in Indian English.');
    };

    c.devGreet = function () {
        unlockAudio();
        var name = (c.data && c.data.user_name) ? c.data.user_name : 'there';
        speak('Hello ' + name + '. I am Netra, ready to help.');
    };

    c.devReplayLast = function () {
        if (!lastReply) { logEvent('dev', 'no last reply to replay'); return; }
        speak(lastReply);
    };

    c.devToggleSleep = function () {
        c.tap();
    };

    c.devRestartRec = function () {
        logEvent('dev', 'restarting recognition session');
        try { if (contRec) contRec.stop(); } catch (e) {}
        // onend will restart automatically
    };

    c.devClearLog = function () {
        c.events = [];
    };

    // R2.7 - exposes Alt+Shift+R as a button click for sighted helpers
    c.devNuclearReset = function () {
        logEvent('warn', 'Reset all clicked - nuclear reset');
        geminiHistory = [];
        recRestartCount = 0;
        ignoreFinalsUntil = Date.now();
        try { if (contRec) contRec.stop(); } catch (e) {}
        try { stopMicLevelMeter(); } catch (e) {}
        $timeout(function () {
            startContinuous();
            startMicLevelMeter();
        }, 300);
    };

    c.devPickVoice = function () {
        forcedVoiceName = c.voicePick || '';
        if (forcedVoiceName) {
            c.voiceName = forcedVoiceName + ' (forced)';
            logEvent('dev', 'voice forced to ' + forcedVoiceName);
        } else {
            logEvent('dev', 'voice auto - re-picking');
            pickFemaleVoice();
        }
    };

    c.devPingServer = function () {
        logEvent('dev', 'pinging server...');
        c.data.action = 'debug';
        c.server.update().then(
            function () {
                var d = c.data.debug || {};
                logEvent('srv', 'ping ok: model=' + d.model + ' key=' + d.api_key_status +
                                ' tools=' + (d.tool_count || '?'));
                if (d.tools && d.tools.length) {
                    logEvent('srv', 'available tools: ' + d.tools.join(', '));
                }
            },
            function (err) {
                logEvent('err', 'ping failed: ' + err);
            }
        );
    };

    c.devToggleTTS = function () {
        // R2.8 - cycle: edge -> gemini -> stream -> browser -> edge
        var seq = ['edge', 'gemini', 'stream', 'browser'];
        var idx = seq.indexOf(c.ttsEngine || 'edge');
        c.ttsEngine = seq[(idx + 1) % seq.length];
        c.useRemoteTTS = (c.ttsEngine !== 'browser');
        logEvent('dev', 'TTS engine -> ' + c.ttsEngine +
                 (c.ttsEngine === 'edge'   ? ' (' + c.edgeVoice + ', Microsoft Neural, free)' :
                  c.ttsEngine === 'gemini' ? ' (' + c.geminiVoice + ', Gemini native, ~1 Gemini quota / turn)' :
                  c.ttsEngine === 'stream' ? ' (StreamElements ' + c.remoteVoice + ')' :
                                             ' (browser ' + c.voiceName + ')'));
    };

    c.devCycleRemoteVoice = function () {
        // R2.8 - cycle voices for the active engine
        if (c.ttsEngine === 'edge') {
            var ei = EDGE_VOICES.indexOf(c.edgeVoice);
            c.edgeVoice = EDGE_VOICES[(ei + 1) % EDGE_VOICES.length];
            logEvent('dev', 'Edge voice -> ' + c.edgeVoice);
            return;
        }
        if (c.ttsEngine === 'gemini') {
            var gi = GEMINI_VOICES.indexOf(c.geminiVoice);
            c.geminiVoice = GEMINI_VOICES[(gi + 1) % GEMINI_VOICES.length];
            logEvent('dev', 'Gemini voice -> ' + c.geminiVoice);
            return;
        }
        var voices = ['Raveena','Aditi','Joanna','Salli','Kimberly','Amy','Emma','Brian','Russell','Nicole','Joey','Matthew'];
        var idx = voices.indexOf(c.remoteVoice);
        c.remoteVoice = voices[(idx + 1) % voices.length];
        logEvent('dev', 'remote voice -> ' + c.remoteVoice);
    };

    c.devCloseConversation = function () {
        closeConversation();
        logEvent('dev', 'conversation manually closed');
    };

    c.devDiagnose = function () {
        logEvent('dev', '=== diagnostics ===');
        logEvent('dev', 'SR=' + c.hasSR + ' TTS=' + c.hasTTS + ' Grammars=' + !!SGL);
        logEvent('dev', 'rec running=' + c.recRunning + ' state=' + c.state + ' alert=' + c.alert + ' conv=' + c.conversationOpen);
        logEvent('dev', 'mic permission=' + c.permission);
        logEvent('dev', 'voice=' + (c.useRemoteTTS ? 'remote ' + c.remoteVoice : c.voiceName));
        var enIn = c.voices.filter(function(v){ return /en[-_]IN/i.test(v.lang); });
        logEvent('dev', 'en-IN voices: ' + (enIn.length ? enIn.map(function(v){return v.name;}).join(', ') : 'NONE'));
        logEvent('dev', 'total browser voices: ' + c.voices.length);
        var v = (c.data && c.data.vocab) || {};

                                          (v.categories||[]).length + ' categories, ' +
                                          (v.kb_titles||[]).length + ' KB titles, ' +

c/* ============================================================
 *  Netra Mic widget - R1 styles (Apple-serene backlit eye)
 *
 *  Calm. Beautiful. Draggable. Shrinkable. The eye is the
 *  whole identity - no HUD lines, no scanners. Soft warm
 *  sclera, layered iris with striations, deep pupil, two
 *  catchlights, gentle backlit halo.
 * ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================
 *  Root - R1.3 small Claude-style mark, default top-left
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-root {
    position: fixed;
    left: 18px;
    top: 18px;
    z-index: 9999;
    font-family: 'Google Sans', 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
}
.netra-root * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.netra-root button { font-family: 'Google Sans', 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }

/* Screen-reader-only */
.netra-sr-only {
    position: absolute !important;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    padding: 0;
    margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0,0,0,0);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  ORB - the EYE (v13, inline SVG, 160x100)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-orb {
    position: relative;
    /* R2.5 - golden-ratio sizing: 72px x 72px (square = ratio 1:1, the orb
       inside is the golden form). Hover scales by phi-1 = 0.618 of step. */
    width: 72px;
    height: 72px;
    border: 0;
    cursor: grab;
    background: transparent;
    padding: 0;
    transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
                filter 0.35s ease,
                width 0.382s ease,        /* 1 - 1/phi seconds */
                height 0.382s ease;
    overflow: visible;
    /* R1.3 - simple green palette + R2.5 golden-ratio additions */
    --iris-bright: #aef0d0;
    --iris-mid:    #2eb858;
    --iris-dark:   #0a4a25;
    --iris-deep:   #021a0d;
    --core-mid:    #aef0d0;
    --eye-glow:    rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.55);
}
.netra-orb:hover  { transform: scale(1.0618); }   /* 1 + 1/phi*0.1 */
.netra-orb:active { cursor: grabbing; transform: scale(0.95); }

/* Shrunk mode - 72 / phi = 44.5 ~ 44 px (golden-ratio shrink) */
.netra-shrunk .netra-orb {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
}
.netra-orb:hover  { transform: scale(1.05); }
.netra-orb:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
.netra-orb:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    --eye-glow: rgba(138, 180, 248, 0.65);
}

.netra-eye-svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
    overflow: visible;
    /* R2.5 - golden-ratio drop shadow: blur radius = 12, offset y = 12/phi = 7.4 */
    filter: drop-shadow(0 7.4px 12px var(--eye-glow, rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.4)));
}

/* R2.5 - Halo pulses on a phi-second cycle (1.618 * 2.236 = ~3.618 s) */
.netra-eye-halo {
    transform-origin: 60px 60px;
    transform-box: view-box;
    animation: netra-halo-pulse 3.618s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes netra-halo-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.62;  transform: scale(0.945); }   /* 1/phi  + halo at rest */
    50%      { opacity: 1;     transform: scale(1.083); }   /* breathing out */
}

/* Pupil breathes on the same phi cycle (in sync with halo) */
.netra-eye-pupil {
    transform-origin: 60px 60px;
    transform-box: view-box;
    animation: netra-pupil-breath 3.618s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes netra-pupil-breath {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1);    }
    50%      { transform: scale(1.083); }
}

/* Catchlight shimmer at golden-cycle (phi^2 = 2.618 s) */
.netra-eye-glint {
    animation: netra-glint-shimmer 2.618s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes netra-glint-shimmer {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.92; }
    50%      { opacity: 0.65; }
}

/* R2.8.2 - audio-reactive voice ring (connected polygon waveform).
   Single polygon whose 24 vertices recompute from c.audioLevel.
   Stroke is the bright neon outline; fill is a translucent radial
   gradient that brightens just outside the sphere edge. */
.netra-voice-ring-group {
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0.95;
    animation: voice-ring-fade-in 0.4s ease-out forwards;
}
.netra-voice-ring-fill {
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    opacity: 0.45;
}
.netra-voice-ring-stroke {
    transition: stroke-width 0.18s ease, filter 0.3s ease;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--iris-bright, rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.7)))
            drop-shadow(0 0 10px var(--iris-bright, rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.3)));
}
@keyframes voice-ring-fade-in {
    from { opacity: 0; }
    to   { opacity: 0.95; }
}

/* When Netra is speaking, the entire aura should EXPAND and brighten.
   Halo scales 1.4x; voice-ring fill is more opaque; stroke is thicker
   with a wider glow. This is the "she is really talking" feel. */
.netra-state-speaking .netra-eye-halo {
    transform: scale(1.42);
    transform-origin: 60px 60px;
    transform-box: view-box;
    animation: halo-pulse-speaking 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.netra-state-speaking .netra-voice-ring-fill   { opacity: 0.75; }
.netra-state-speaking .netra-voice-ring-stroke {
    stroke-width: 2.2;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--iris-bright, rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.85)))
            drop-shadow(0 0 16px var(--iris-bright, rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.5)))
            drop-shadow(0 0 26px var(--iris-bright, rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.25)));
}
@keyframes halo-pulse-speaking {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1.32); opacity: 0.85; }
    50%      { transform: scale(1.52); opacity: 1;    }
}

/* While listening the halo is only slightly larger - subtle activity. */
.netra-state-idle .netra-eye-halo {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    transform-origin: 60px 60px;
    transform-box: view-box;
}

/* The inscribed pentagram rotates SLOWLY - one full turn every 21 sec
   (the 7th Fibonacci number * 3, deliberately divisible by phi). */
.netra-eye-pentagram {
    transform-origin: 60px 60px;
    transform-box: view-box;
    animation: netra-pentagram-spin 21s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes netra-pentagram-spin {
    from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
    to   { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.netra-eye-glow {
    transition: stroke 0.4s ease, stroke-width 0.4s ease;
    filter: blur(4px);
}

.netra-eye-iris {
    transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

.netra-eye-iris-group {
    transform-origin: 80px 50px;
    transition: transform 0.35s ease;
}

.netra-eye-pupil {
    transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

.netra-eye-lid-top,
.netra-eye-lid-bottom {
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.netra-eye-glint,
.netra-eye-glint-small {
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, fill 0.3s ease;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  State - IDLE (neon green HUD - default)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-state-idle .netra-orb {
    --iris-bright: #7fffb0;
    --iris-dark:   #0a6633;
    --iris-deep:   #021a0d;
    --eye-glow:    rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.55);
    --accent:      #aef0d0;
    --core-mid:    #7fffb0;
}
.netra-state-idle .netra-eye-glow {
    animation: eye-glow-pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.netra-state-idle .netra-eye-lid-top {
    animation: eye-blink-top 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.netra-state-idle .netra-eye-lid-bottom {
    animation: eye-blink-bottom 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  State - AWAITING (soft amber, ready for command)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-state-awaiting .netra-orb {
    --iris-bright: #ffd9a0;
    --iris-mid:    #d49654;
    --iris-dark:   #8a5a20;
    --iris-deep:   #3d260a;
    --eye-glow:    rgba(255, 200, 120, 0.6);
}
.netra-state-awaiting .netra-eye-pupil {
    transform: scale(1.25);
}
.netra-state-awaiting .netra-eye-lid-top {
    animation: eye-blink-top 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.netra-state-awaiting .netra-eye-lid-bottom {
    animation: eye-blink-bottom 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  State - LISTENING (rosy attention - clear visual cue)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-state-listening .netra-orb {
    --iris-bright: #ffb0a0;
    --iris-mid:    #d05050;
    --iris-dark:   #8a2020;
    --iris-deep:   #3d0a0a;
    --eye-glow:    rgba(255, 130, 130, 0.7);
}
.netra-state-listening .netra-eye-pupil {
    transform: scale(1.55);
}
.netra-state-listening .netra-eye-glow {
    animation: eye-glow-fast 0.7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.netra-state-listening .netra-eye-lid-top {
    animation: eye-blink-top 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.netra-state-listening .netra-eye-lid-bottom {
    animation: eye-blink-bottom 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  State - THINKING (warm gold, iris drifts slightly)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-state-thinking .netra-orb {
    --iris-bright: #ffe5a0;
    --iris-mid:    #d49530;
    --iris-dark:   #8a5800;
    --iris-deep:   #3d2700;
    --eye-glow:    rgba(255, 210, 100, 0.6);
}
.netra-state-thinking .netra-eye-pupil {
    animation: pupil-breath 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.netra-state-thinking .netra-eye-iris-group {
    animation: eye-iris-spin 1.6s linear infinite;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  State - SPEAKING (calm sage green, soft glow)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-state-speaking .netra-orb {
    --iris-bright: #b5e5c5;
    --iris-mid:    #5ac085;
    --iris-dark:   #1a7040;
    --iris-deep:   #0a3320;
    --eye-glow:    rgba(140, 220, 170, 0.6);
}
.netra-state-speaking .netra-eye-iris {
    animation: eye-iris-breathe 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: center;
}
.netra-state-speaking .netra-eye-lid-top {
    animation: eye-blink-top 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.netra-state-speaking .netra-eye-lid-bottom {
    animation: eye-blink-bottom 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  State - DORMANT (eyelids closed, dimmed)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-state-dormant .netra-orb {
    --iris-bright: #6a7480;
    --iris-mid:    #404a58;
    --iris-dark:   #1e2530;
    --iris-deep:   #0a1018;
    --eye-glow:    rgba(80, 90, 105, 0.25);
    filter: brightness(0.65) saturate(0.6);
}
.netra-state-dormant .netra-eye-lid-top   { opacity: 0.92; }
.netra-state-dormant .netra-eye-glint     { opacity: 0;    }
.netra-state-dormant .netra-eye-glint-small { opacity: 0;  }
.netra-state-dormant .netra-eye-iris      { opacity: 0.35; }
.netra-state-dormant .netra-eye-pupil     { opacity: 0.4;  }
.netra-state-dormant .netra-eye-pentagram { opacity: 0;    }

/* ============================================================
 *  State - PAUSED
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-state-paused .netra-orb {
    --iris-bright: #c4c7c5;
    --iris-dark:   #9aa0a6;
    --iris-deep:   #5f6368;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  State - ERROR (soft red, gentle shake - not alarming)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-state-error .netra-orb {
    --iris-bright: #ffa090;
    --iris-mid:    #d05050;
    --iris-dark:   #8a2020;
    --iris-deep:   #3d0a0a;
    --eye-glow:    rgba(255, 130, 130, 0.7);
    animation: eye-shake 0.45s ease;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  State - BOOT
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-state-boot .netra-orb { filter: brightness(0.85); }
.netra-state-boot .netra-eye-iris-group { opacity: 0.7; }

/* ============================================================
 *  Keyframes
 * ============================================================ */
@keyframes eye-glow-pulse {
    0%   { stroke-width: 1.5; opacity: 0.6; }
    50%  { stroke-width: 3;   opacity: 1;   }
    100% { stroke-width: 1.5; opacity: 0.6; }
}

@keyframes eye-glow-fast {
    0%   { stroke-width: 2; opacity: 0.6; }
    50%  { stroke-width: 5; opacity: 1;   }
    100% { stroke-width: 2; opacity: 0.6; }
}

@keyframes eye-iris-spin {
    from { transform: rotate(0deg);   }
    to   { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes eye-iris-breathe {
    0%   { transform: scale(1);    }
    50%  { transform: scale(1.09); }
    100% { transform: scale(1);    }
}

@keyframes eye-shake {
    0%   { transform: translateX(0); }
    20%  { transform: translateX(-5px) rotate(-1.5deg); }
    50%  { transform: translateX(5px)  rotate(1.5deg);  }
    80%  { transform: translateX(-3px) rotate(-0.8deg); }
    100% { transform: translateX(0); }
}

@keyframes eye-blink-top {
    0%   { transform: translateY(0); }
    94%  { transform: translateY(0); }
    97%  { transform: translateY(60px); }
    100% { transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes eye-blink-bottom {
    0%   { transform: translateY(0); }
    94%  { transform: translateY(0); }
    97%  { transform: translateY(-60px); }
    100% { transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ============================================================
 *  Initial-gesture gate
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-gate {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 16px 22px 16px 18px;
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border: 2px solid #4285F4;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.28);
    color: #202124;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
    max-width: 340px;
    text-align: left;
    animation: gate-in 0.3s ease;
}
.netra-gate:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.36);
}
.netra-gate:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid #4285F4;
    outline-offset: 3px;
}

.netra-gate-icon {
    color: #4285F4;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex: none;
}
.netra-gate-text {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    line-height: 1.35;
}
.netra-gate-text strong { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #202124; }
.netra-gate-text span   { font-size: 13px; color: #5F6368; }

@keyframes gate-in {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ============================================================
 *  Transcript card (sighted-helper preview)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-card {
    width: 360px;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 56px);
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(36, 36, 56, 0.96), rgba(18, 18, 28, 0.96));
    border: 1px solid rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.25);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 0 18px rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.18);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(140%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(140%);
    color: #ebedf2;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    animation: card-in 0.25s ease;
    transition: box-shadow 0.35s ease, border-color 0.35s ease;
}
.netra-card-speaking {
    box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 0 26px rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.55);
    border-color: rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.6);
}
.netra-card-meta {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    color: #6b7178;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    padding-top: 4px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}
.netra-card-meta span:not(:last-child)::after {
    content: '�';
    margin-left: 8px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
}
/* R2.4 - clickable link fallback when popup blocked */
.netra-card-link {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.18);
    color: #aef0d0 !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.4);
    border-radius: 8px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
    word-break: break-all;
}
.netra-card-link:hover {
    background: rgba(127, 255, 176, 0.3);
    text-decoration: none;
}
@keyframes card-in {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
.netra-card-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    align-items: flex-start;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.45;
}
.netra-card-label {
    flex: none;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: #9aa0a6;
    padding-top: 3px;
    width: 42px;
}
.netra-card-row-bot .netra-card-label { color: #a5d6a7; }
.netra-card-text {
    color: #ebedf2;
    word-break: break-word;
    line-height: 1.5;
    font-size: 13px;
}
.netra-card-row-bot .netra-card-text {
    color: #ffffff;
}

/* ============================================================
 *  DEV PANEL (v13 - glassmorphic console)
 * ============================================================ */
.netra-dev {
    position: fixed;
    top: 18px;
    left: 100px;      /* R1.3 - to the right of the small orb */
    z-index: 100000;
    width: 380px;
    max-width: 92vw;
    max-height: 88vh;
    overflow: auto;
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px 14px 14px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.netra-dev {
    background: rgb(26, 26, 36);
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(36, 36, 56, 0.92), rgba(18, 18, 28, 0.92));
    box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
}
.netra-dev section { margin: 10px 0; }
.netra-dev button {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a3d49 0%, #2c2f3a 100%);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.1;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    transition: transform 0.08s ease, background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04) inset, 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
}
.netra-dev button:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #45495a 0%, #353945 100%);

    box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
}
.netra-dev button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); }
.netra-dev button:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

.netra-dev-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    margin-bottom: 0;
    cursor: grab;   /* R1.3 - draggable header */
    user-select: none;
}
.netra-dev-head:active { cursor: grabbing; }
/* R2.5 - NETRA wordmark removed; version pill stretches to fill the gap */
.netra-dev-ver {
    flex: 1;
    color: #9aa0a6;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-left: 2px;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: #9aa0a6;
}

/* Animated live mic indicator */
.netra-dev-live {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #5f6368;
    flex: none;
    transition: background 0.25s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(129, 201, 149, 0);
}
.netra-dev-live.on {
    background: #81c995;
    animation: netra-live-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes netra-live-pulse {
    0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0   rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.6); }
    50%  { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(129, 201, 149, 0);   }
    100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0   rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.6); }
}

.netra-dev-pill {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 3px 9px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: #ebedf2;
    transition: background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
}
.netra-dev-pill-idle      { background: rgba(138,180,248,0.18); color: #aecbfa; }
.netra-dev-pill-listening { background: rgba(255,118,118,0.20); color: #ff9b9b; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,118,118,0.35); }
.netra-dev-pill-awaiting  { background: rgba(174,213,129,0.20); color: #c5e1a5; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(174,213,129,0.35); }
.netra-dev-pill-thinking  { background: rgba(249,171,0,0.22);   color: #ffd54f; }
.netra-dev-pill-speaking  { background: rgba(129,201,149,0.22); color: #a5d6a7; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(129,201,149,0.35); }
.netra-dev-pill-paused    { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #c4c7c5; }
.netra-dev-pill-dormant   { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #9aa0a6; }
.netra-dev-pill-error     { background: rgba(255,118,118,0.22); color: #ff9b9b; }
.netra-dev-pill-boot      { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #c4c7c5; }
.netra-dev-pill-mode      { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #9aa0a6; }
.netra-dev-pill-mode.on   { background: rgba(129,201,149,0.20); color: #a5d6a7; }

.netra-dev-x {
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 3px 8px !important;
    opacity: 0.7;
}
.netra-dev-x:hover { opacity: 1; }

.netra-dev-status,
.netra-dev-transcript {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
}
.netra-dev-status div,
.netra-dev-transcript div {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 3px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}
.netra-dev-status div:last-child,
.netra-dev-transcript div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.netra-dev-status div span:first-child,
.netra-dev-transcript div span:first-child {
    color: #9aa0a6;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    flex: none;
}
.netra-dev-status div b,
.netra-dev-status div em,
.netra-dev-transcript div b,
.netra-dev-transcript div em {
    color: #ebedf2;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-style: normal;
    text-align: right;
    word-break: break-word;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', 'Monaco', monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px;
}
.netra-dev-status div em.on,
.netra-dev-transcript div em.on {
    color: #f9ab00;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(249, 171, 0, 0.4);
}
.netra-dev-status div b.on,
.netra-dev-transcript div b.on {
    color: #a5d6a7;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.4);
}
.netra-dev-status div b.l-err,
.netra-dev-transcript div b.l-err { color: #ff7676; }

.netra-dev-tx-row em {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: left;
    margin-left: 10px;
}

.netra-dev-input {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
}
.netra-dev-input input {
    flex: 1;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    outline: none;
    transition: border 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.netra-dev-input input::placeholder { color: #6b7178; }
.netra-dev-input input:focus {
    border-color: rgba(138, 180, 248, 0.6);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(138, 180, 248, 0.12);
}

.netra-dev-actions {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 6px;
}
.netra-dev-actions button { white-space: nowrap; }

/* R1.2 - LIVE MIC LEVEL METER */
.netra-mic-meter {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
}
.netra-mic-meter-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    color: #9aa0a6;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.netra-mic-meter-status {
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    color: #c4c7c5;
}
.netra-mic-meter-status.on {
    background: rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.25);
    color: #a5d6a7;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.4);
}
.netra-mic-meter-status.l-err {
    background: rgba(255, 118, 118, 0.2);
    color: #ff9b9b;
}
.netra-mic-meter-peak {
    margin-left: auto;
    color: #6b7178;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: 0;
}
.netra-mic-meter-track {
    height: 10px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    border-radius: 5px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}
.netra-mic-meter-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6dd882 0%, #ffe082 60%, #ff7676 95%);
    border-radius: 5px;
    transition: width 0.08s linear;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(129, 201, 149, 0.5);
}
.netra-mic-meter-test {
    margin-top: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
}
.netra-mic-meter-test button {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a3d49 0%, #2c2f3a 100%);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.netra-mic-meter-test button:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }
.netra-mic-meter-test em {
    color: #aecbfa;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* R1 - Real-time graphs */
.netra-dev-graphs {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}
.netra-graph-card {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
}
.netra-graph-title {
    color: #9aa0a6;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}
.netra-graph-sub {
    color: #6b7178;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: 0;
}
/* R2.8 - inline numeric labels on graphs */
.netra-graph-title { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; }
.netra-graph-stats {
    margin-left: auto;
    color: #ebedf2;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 9px;
    text-transform: none;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
}
.netra-graph-dim { color: #6b7178; font-weight: 400; }
.netra-graph-svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 40px;
    display: block;
}
.netra-graph-bars { padding-bottom: 6px; }
.netra-bar-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr 24px;
    gap: 6px;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 2px 0;
    color: #c4c7c5;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
}
.netra-bar-label {
    color: #aecbfa;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.netra-bar-track {
    height: 6px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.netra-bar-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #8ab4f8, #c39bd3);
    border-radius: 3px;
    transition: width 0.4s ease;
}
.netra-bar-count {
    text-align: right;
    color: #ebedf2;
}
.netra-bar-empty {
    color: #6b7178;
    font-style: italic;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 6px 0;
    font-size: 10.5px;
}

/* R2.2 - voice training */
.netra-dev-train {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}
.netra-train-title {
    color: #aecbfa;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
}
.netra-train-sub {
    color: #6b7178;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    text-transform: none;
    margin-left: auto;
}
.netra-train-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
}
.netra-train-row input {
    flex: 1;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: inherit;
    outline: none;
    min-width: 0;
}
.netra-train-row input::placeholder { color: #6b7178; }
.netra-train-row button {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a3d49 0%, #2c2f3a 100%);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    flex: none;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.netra-train-row button:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.netra-train-half { flex: 1; }
.netra-train-arrow {
    color: #aecbfa;
    font-size: 12px;
    flex: none;
}
.netra-train-aliases {
    max-height: 80px;
    overflow: auto;
    padding: 4px 0;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
    font-size: 9.5px;
}
.netra-train-alias {
    padding: 1px 0;
    color: #c4c7c5;
}
.netra-train-alias-misheard { color: #ff9b9b; }
.netra-train-alias-arrow    { color: #6b7178; padding: 0 4px; }
.netra-train-alias-intended { color: #a5d6a7; }
.netra-train-clear {
    background: rgba(255, 118, 118, 0.12);
    color: #ff9b9b;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 118, 118, 0.2);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    align-self: flex-start;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.netra-train-clear:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 118, 118, 0.2);
}

/* R1.4 - last-turn tool trace */
.netra-trace-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr 24px 32px;
    gap: 4px;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
    padding: 2px 0;
}
.netra-trace-step {
    background: rgba(127,255,176,0.18);
    color: #a5d6a7;
    border-radius: 3px;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 9px;
    padding: 1px 0;
}
.netra-trace-name {
    color: #aecbfa;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.netra-trace-arrow {
    color: #6b7178;
    text-align: right;
}
.netra-trace-ok {
    color: #a5d6a7;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 9px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.netra-dev-voices label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    color: #9aa0a6;
}
.netra-dev-voices label span { flex: none; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.netra-dev-voices label select {
    flex: 1;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
    color: #ebedf2;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    outline: none;
}

.netra-dev-log {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    max-height: 260px;
    overflow: auto;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', 'Monaco', monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    line-height: 1.55;
}
.netra-dev-log-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 56px 50px 1fr;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 1px 0;
    color: #c4c7c5;
    word-break: break-word;
}
.netra-dev-log-row .t { color: #6b7178; }
.netra-dev-log-row .l {
    color: #9aa0a6;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.netra-dev-log-row .m { color: #e6e6ec; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-err   .l,
.netra-dev-log-row.l-err   .m { color: #ff7676; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-wake  .l { color: #34a853; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-cmd   .l { color: #f9ab00; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-dev   .l { color: #8ab4f8; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-srv   .l { color: #d96570; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-perm  .l { color: #c39bd3; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-init  .l { color: #c4c7c5; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-boot  .l { color: #81c995; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-tts   .l { color: #4dd0e1; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-conv  .l { color: #a5d6a7; }
.netra-dev-log-row.l-poll  .l { color: #80cbc4; opacity: 0.7; }

.netra-dev-log-empty {
    color: #6b7178;
    font-style: italic;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 12px 0;
}

.netra-dev-badge {
    position: fixed;
    top: 14px;
    left: 14px;
    z-index: 100000;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(36,36,56,0.92), rgba(18,18,28,0.92));
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(140%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(140%);
    color: #aecbfa;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', 'Monaco', monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.netra-dev-badge:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

/* ============================================================
 *  Responsive
 * ============================================================ */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .netra-root { right: 16px; bottom: 16px; }
    .netra-orb  { width: 72px; height: 72px; }
    .netra-dev  { width: calc(100vw - 24px); }
    .netra-dev-actions { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

}Netra Mic[]false/**
 * Netra Mic widget - SERVER SCRIPT  (Release 2 - web + in-tab control)
 *
 * R1.4 adds 4 tools: list_capabilities (introspection),
 *   recall_past_conversations (long-term memory recall),
 *   remember_fact (long-term memory write), analyze_screenshot
 *   (multimodal vision signal). Memory + draft now coexist in a
 *   single unified CTX: JSON blob in last_utterance. Daily briefing
 *   upgraded with PROACTIVE highlights (top P1, oldest approval,
 *   unread watchlist activity). Gemini contents now accept image
 *   inlineData for screenshot analysis.
 *
 *
 * Powered by Google's Gemini API with full function-calling (tool use).
 * The model decides when to call tools (create ticket, list, resolve,
 * search knowledge, etc.) and Netra carries out the action via
 * NetraTools / NetraKnowledge Script Includes, then loops the result
 * back to the model for a natural-language reply.
 *
 * Setup:
 *   System Property  x_196061_netra_v1.gemini_api_key   = <your key>
 *   System Property  x_196061_netra_v1.gemini_model     = gemini-2.5-flash  (optional)
 *
 *   Get a free Gemini API key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
 *
 * Protocol:
 *   input.action == 'chat'      -> input.message, input.history -> data.response
 *   input.action == 'poll'      -> data.notifications
 *   input.action == 'reset'     -> clears server-side memory (history is client-side)
 *   (initial load)              -> data.user_name, data.paused, data.has_api_key
 */
(function () {

    var SCOPE = 'x_196061_netra_v1';
    var user  = gs.getUserID();

    // ---- Always-on state ----
    data.user_name   = gs.getUserDisplayName();
    data.user_sys_id = user;
    data.error       = null;
    data.has_api_key = !!gs.getProperty(SCOPE + '.gemini_api_key');

    _ensurePref();
    _setPauseState();
    data.vocab = _getVocab();

    // R2.3 - per-user voice training (vocab + aliases) lives in the
    // Netra Context row. Expose it to the client on every load so it
    // can rebuild the personal recognizer hints from server truth.
    try {
        var trainSnap = _trainingRead();
        data.training = {
            vocab:   trainSnap.vocab   || {},
            aliases: trainSnap.aliases || {}
        };
    } catch (eT) { data.training = { vocab: {}, aliases: {} }; }

    var action = (input && input.action) ? String(input.action) : null;

    if (action === 'chat') {
        try {
            data.response = _chat(
                String((input && input.message) || '').trim(),
                (input && Array.isArray(input.history)) ? input.history : []
            );
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[NetraGemini] chat outer error: ' + e);
            data.response = { ok: false, message: 'Sorry, I hit a server error: ' + String(e.message || e) };
        }
    } else if (action === 'poll') {
        try {
            if (data.paused) {
                data.notifications = [];
            } else {
                var gr = new GlideRecord(SCOPE + '_notification');
                gr.addQuery('user', user);
                gr.addQuery('delivered', false);
                gr.orderBy('sys_created_on');
                gr.setLimit(10);
                gr.query();
                var out = [];
                while (gr.next()) {
                    out.push({
                        id: String(gr.sys_id),
                        message: String(gr.message),
                        kind: String(gr.kind),
                        ticket_number: String(gr.ticket_number)
                    });

                    gr.delivered_at = new GlideDateTime();

            } else {

                    vocab_count:   Object.keys(saved.vocab).length,
                    aliases_count: Object.keys(saved.aliases).length,

                };

        } catch (eTS) {
            data.training_result = { ok: false, error: String(eTS.message || eTS) };

    } else if (action === 'gemini_tts') {

        // service. Returns base64 PCM 24kHz mono which the client wraps

        try {
